title: Home-care accessibility in Japan: open-source geospatial workflow
description: Consolidated R/OSRM workflow accompanying a nationwide cross-sectional geospatial informatics assessment of potential accessibility to home-care support facilities in Japan, comparing the 16-km criterion with road-network travel-time scenarios and including network-snapping, same-facility, and diagnostic CSIS address-matching quality-control workflows. JMAP-derived facility-level data are not redistributed; synthetic demonstration inputs are included.
